content:
Maya S: FYI — I’m seeing a handful of GPU nodes in ap-southeast-2 where pods in the inference pool are CrashLoopBackOff. Logs show missing env vars from sealed secrets. Anyone else?
Infra Bot: deploy pipeline: gitops/infra apply failed on k8s-cluster-ap-southeast-2: sealedsecrets controller -> KMS permission denied (403). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/2143658700
Raj P: I noticed this during the autoscaler churn. Terraform drift changed node label key name in the ASG template. Autoscaler selects on `pool=redwood-gpu` but some new nodes came up with `gpu-pool=true`. :thinking_face:
Oliver T: That explains why pods weren’t scheduled onto the right nodes and why the env-injector pod couldn't find the annotated nodes. SealedSecrets itself is cluster-scoped, but our helm overlay for the injector has a nodeSelector that relied on the old label.
Sara L: Failing pod log snippet:
```
Error: failed to decrypt secret: kms: PermissionDenied
at secrets.go:142
```
Looks like the controller also couldn’t contact the KMS alias in the region (403).
Sara L: Helm values from the deploy overlay show the bad nodeSelector: 
```
nodeSelector:
  gpu-pool: "true"
```
Terraform ASG template now emits label `pool=redwood-gpu` (note the different key and value).
Ops Eng: We can hotfix by relabeling the nodes to match the injector, or patch the helm release. Quick commands: `kubectl label node <node-name> pool=redwood-gpu --overwrite` and then `kubectl get nodes -l pool=redwood-gpu`. I’d prefer relabeling to avoid an immediate helm roll.
Raj P: Also found root cause for KMS 403 — the KMS alias in ap-southeast-2 wasn’t bound to the service account used by sealed-secrets. Terraform apply for the kms_binding timed out in last run (pipeline timeout). I’ll re-run `terraform apply -target=google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.kms_binding` and follow up.
Maya S: If we patch labels and the IAM binding, should we restart the sealed-secrets controller to pick up creds? @Infra Bot can you schedule a rolling restart in that cluster so pods re-evaluate secrets?
Infra Bot: Scheduled: rolling restart for namespace=secrets, deployment=sealed-secrets-controller on k8s-cluster-ap-southeast-2 in 2m. CI job: jobs/roll/sealedsecrets/2143658700.
Oliver T: After relabel + IAM fix, I saw secrets decrypt and pods pulled envs. Proposal: add a gitops CI gate that asserts `nodeLabels` in Terraform templates match the expected set in Helm overlays and that the KMS binding resource is present. Example assertion in CI: `terraform plan | grep "pool=redwood-gpu"` and `kubectl get secretsealed -n secrets --all-namespaces | jq '.metadata.annotations["kms-binding"]'`.
Maya S: One more thing — cost note: some of the recovered nodes were created using `m60-highmem` because the instance_profile var defaulted incorrectly in the TF module during the failed run. We had a ~30% cost spike for the cluster while this was happening. Put an audit item in the followup. :money_with_wings:
